name: borgmatic Open-Source Backup Automation
free_limit: GPL-3.0-or-later configuration-driven automation for BorgBackup with backup scheduling, retention, consistency checks and hooks; no vendor software subscription or storage quota.
watch_out: Requires BorgBackup and your own local or remote backup destination. Disks, servers, object storage, network transfer and maintenance may cost money. GPLv3 redistribution obligations apply; borgmatic is backup orchestration, not a duplicate listing for the BorgBackup engine.
